title: MultiGlobeQA: A Multilingual and Globally Diverse Benchmark for Geospatial Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy (Exact Match and Normalized Error) on geospatial reasoning questions stratified by the target geographic entity's World Bank income tier (low, lower-middle, upper-middle, and high-income countries).

Evaluating model performance on spatial questions stratified by population density tiers (low, medium, and high density) based on global raster data to measure performance disparities between urban and sparsely populated regions.

Testing models on a parallel set of identical geospatial reasoning questions translated into 17 high- and low-resource languages to isolate language-specific performance drops from general question difficulty.
